lesson.title: Lesson Drafter
lesson.description: Create a structured lesson plan from a title.
lesson.plan:
# Lesson Plan: {{topic}}
**Context**: {{context}}

## Learning Objectives
1. Understand the core concepts of {{topic}}.
2. Apply {{topic}} in real-world scenarios.

## Introduction (5 mins)
- Hook: Start with an interesting fact about {{topic}}.
- Definition: Define key terms.

## Main Content (20 mins)
- Concept A: Detailed explanation.
- Concept B: Common pitfalls.
- Activity: Group discussion.

## Conclusion (5 mins)
- Recap key points.
- Q&A session.
